name: pdf-page
description: Local Quartz 5 page type plugin that gives every PDF in content/ a wrapper page, so it shows up in the explorer, search, and content index instead of only being reachable by direct URL. Generated entirely in memory at build time — nothing is written to content/.

quartz.name: pdf-page
quartz.description: Generates a virtual wrapper page for every PDF in the vault so it appears in the file tree/search, without writing markdown files to content/.
